Service Overview

Roadside Assistance Dubai - On-Site Mechanical Triage & Recovery Support

A breakdown on busy Dubai routes—such as Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, or neighborhood access streets—requires calm, safe action. High ambient heat places significant strain on car batteries, cooling systems, and tyre rubber. When your vehicle stops working in a parking area, community road, or roadside shoulder, our primary focus is assessing whether the problem can be resolved safely on location or requires recovery to our workshop.

Dispatched from our workshop at 222 Al Satwa Road, our technicians carry portable 12V booster packs, tyre changing tools, digital battery testers, and handheld OBD scan tools. We assist with jump starts, on-site battery replacement for common vehicle models, puncture plug repairs, spare tyre fitment, and emergency fuel delivery. For severe issues such as cooling failures, broken drive belts, or transmission immobilisation, we coordinate flatbed recovery to our workshop for comprehensive car engine service.

We operate daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM across central Dubai. All call-out fees and service costs are confirmed with you over the phone or WhatsApp before dispatch, ensuring transparent pricing with no unexpected roadside surprises. To request assistance, call our workshop directly or share your location via WhatsApp.

Roadside Assistance Services & Rates

Transparent roadside rates confirmed over phone or WhatsApp before dispatch. Charges depend on location, vehicle type, and fault requirements.

Battery Jump Start & Testing

AED 60–100 jump start / From AED 180 with battery replacement

On-site jump-start assistance using voltage-regulated booster packs to protect vehicle control units. We perform digital conductance battery testing on-site where equipment is available. If the battery is completely failed, replacement can be supplied subject to compatible stock availability.

Resolution: Resolved on-site where feasible

Puncture Repair & Spare Fitting

AED 55–80 puncture repair / spare wheel fitting

Roadside evaluation of flat or punctured tyres. Permanent plug repairs are performed only when damage is limited to the central tread area. For sidewall damage, shoulder tears, or blowouts, we fit your vehicle's spare wheel or coordinate workshop tyre replacement.

Resolution: On-site repair or spare fitted

Engine Overheating Triage

From AED 80 visual check & triage

Sudden overheating requires stopping immediately to prevent severe cylinder head warping. Technicians inspect for visible hose ruptures, external coolant leaks, and fan operation once the engine cools. Minor hose tightening or coolant top-up can be handled roadside; internal failures require recovery.

Resolution: On-site triage / recovery if severe

Vehicle Lockout Assistance

AED 100–180 (subject to vehicle model)

Non-destructive door entry techniques when keys are locked inside passenger vehicles. Service is subject to technician tool capability and verified vehicle ownership. High-security deadlocked electronic systems may require specialized dealer or locksmith intervention.

Resolution: Resolved on-site where supported

Emergency Fuel Delivery

AED 80 call-out fee + fuel at pump price

Roadside delivery of petrol or diesel in approved safety containers for motorists stranded with an empty tank. We confirm your engine's exact fuel grade prior to dispatch, providing sufficient fuel to safely reach the nearest service station.

Resolution: Resolved on-site

Minor Electrical & Starting Faults

From AED 80 diagnosis & basic labour

Roadside inspection for unexpected starter silence, alternator warning lights, or blown primary fuses. Loose battery terminals, corroded leads, and accessible relays can be rectified roadside; complex internal wiring faults require workshop diagnosis.

Resolution: Depends on fault complexity

Roadside OBD-II Diagnostic Scan

AED 80–100 diagnostic scan

Connection of an OBD-II diagnostic scanner to read active trouble codes following sudden check engine warnings or limp-mode triggers on supported models. The scan helps determine whether your vehicle is mechanically safe to drive or requires flatbed recovery.

Resolution: On-site diagnostic assessment

Vehicle Recovery Coordination

AED 150–300 typical central Dubai recovery

When roadside repairs are unsafe or mechanically impossible—such as transmission failure, broken drive belts, seized brakes, or severe mechanical faults—we coordinate flatbed towing to our 222 Al Satwa Road workshop through vetted recovery partners.

Resolution: Workshop recovery coordination

Rates apply to daytime dispatch across central Dubai (Al Satwa, Jumeirah, Business Bay, DIFC, SZR, Bur Dubai). Towing charges reflect standard flatbed recovery within central Dubai limits. Fuel delivery is charged for fuel cost at pump rates plus delivery call-out fee. All replacement parts or additional garage repairs require prior customer approval.

Emergency Workflow

Our 4-Stage Roadside Assistance Protocol

A structured safety workflow designed to secure passenger well-being, protect the vehicle, and restore mobility safely.

1

Safety First & Pin Sharing

Move vehicle to a safe position if possible, turn on hazard lights, exit away from traffic, and share your WhatsApp live GPS pin and vehicle symptoms.

2

3

On-Site Assessment & Safe Repair

4

Verification or Recovery Coordination

4 Immediate Actions When Stranded

Step 1

Move to Safety if Safe to Do So

If your car is still driveable, steer onto the hard shoulder, emergency lay-by, or off-street parking. If stuck in an active lane and unable to move, keep seatbelts fastened, turn on hazard lights, and call 999 immediately.

Step 2

Activate Hazard Lights & Ensure Visibility

Turn on hazard warning lights immediately to alert oncoming drivers. Never walk into live highway traffic or attempt to place a warning triangle on high-speed motorways where it puts you in danger.

Step 3

Exit Safely & Wait Behind Barriers

Exit through the passenger-side doors away from passing traffic. Wait safely behind the metallic crash barrier or off the roadway. Never stand directly in front of or behind your disabled vehicle.

Step 4

Follow Authority Directions & Share GPS Pin

Follow all Dubai Police and RTA patrol instructions. Once in a secure position, call +971 56 612 1423 or send a WhatsApp GPS pin so our workshop team can confirm availability and dispatch support.

FAQ

Roadside Assistance Dubai - Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do immediately if my car breaks down on Sheikh Zayed Road?

Guide your vehicle onto the hard shoulder or nearest emergency lay-by if safe to do so. Turn on your hazard warning lights immediately. Never walk across active highway lanes or stand directly in front of or behind your vehicle. Exit carefully through the passenger-side door away from live traffic and wait behind the metallic safety crash barrier. If you are stranded in a live lane or cannot reach safety, call 999 immediately. Once secure, call our workshop at +971 56 612 1423 or WhatsApp your live location so our team can assess assistance options.

What is the difference between roadside assistance, vehicle recovery, and towing?

Roadside assistance involves on-site troubleshooting and minor mechanical fixes—such as battery jump starts, spare tyre fitting, tread puncture repairs, and emergency fuel delivery—to restore mobility without moving the car elsewhere. Vehicle recovery involves winching or extracting an immobilized vehicle from difficult terrain, sand, or low-clearance basement parking. Towing or flatbed recovery involves loading a disabled vehicle onto a recovery truck and transporting it safely to our Al Satwa workshop or customer-designated facility.

Is roadside assistance covered by car insurance or vehicle warranties in Dubai?

Many comprehensive motor insurance policies and new-vehicle dealer warranties in the UAE include roadside assistance, though terms, waiting times, and distance limits vary significantly. Some policies cover only basic towing up to a fixed kilometer radius and exclude battery replacement parts. If your insurer has extended response delays or you prefer direct assistance from experienced mechanics, Dubai Car Repair Service provides transparent pay-as-you-go dispatch with detailed, itemized receipts.

Do you provide 24/7 roadside assistance in Dubai?

Dubai Car Repair Service provides roadside assistance during our confirmed workshop hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, seven days a week. For emergencies occurring outside these operating hours, we advise contacting Dubai Police, RTA emergency services, or your insurer's 24-hour roadside hotline.

Can you fix my car at the roadside or will I need towing?

Whether a vehicle can be repaired roadside depends entirely on the nature of the fault and the safety of the location. Common issues such as discharged batteries, central tread punctures, fuel exhaustion, and loose electrical connections are typically resolved on-site. However, major mechanical breakdowns—including internal engine overheating, transmission failure, broken drive belts, seized brakes, or severe collision damage—require flatbed recovery to our Al Satwa workshop. We always evaluate the fault first and explain your options clearly.

My engine overheated and a warning light is on — can I keep driving?

No. You should never continue driving an overheated vehicle. In Dubai's warm climate, driving with an elevated temperature gauge or coolant warning can warp aluminum cylinder heads, crack engine blocks, or blow head gaskets within minutes. Pull over safely onto the shoulder or nearest parking spot, switch off the engine immediately, and allow it to cool down completely. Never attempt to remove a hot radiator or coolant reservoir cap, as pressurized boiling coolant can cause severe burns. Contact our team for on-site assessment or recovery coordination.
